note: Category name and number of people.

en:
I'll show you the pride
of the head of the
Mouri clan!

The Mouri clan's fate is
at stake! I cannot lose!

Take that!
This is the eldest
brother's spearwork!

If I don't hold firm,
Father can't retire
in peace.

If I lose here, my father,
Lord Motonari, will laugh
at me from the beyond!

Father, Lord Motonari!
Watch over me!

I'll show you the finest
valor in all the West!

As if you could stop
the advance of Motoharu!

I must do my part
and Father's too!

I can't disgrace
my father's name!

I'll show you I have
more than just my wits.

Just attacking wildly
isn't the answer.
note: [edit: acc 011 return: 'not enough' implied wild attacks are needed but insufficient; the Japanese says they are not the way]

Retainer's cry. 'Lord' chosen because Terumoto leads battles after he becomes head of the clan; a single shared string, so the Master/Lord succession split (U05353/U05415) cannot be applied per scene.

en:
I'll show you the
fruits of my training!

Why don't you just
retreat already?!

The Amago clan...
will never perish!
note: One Japanese line split in two for the 26-byte balloon line.

en:
With the realm in sight,
I cannot lose!

Back, you wretch!
I'll cut you down!

The realm belongs to
me, Mitsuhide! No one
will stand in my way!

After coming this far,
I won't be beaten now!

The Tokugawa have Ii's
red-armored corps!

Ii Naomasa, Tokugawa
vanguard, has arrived!

Sakon! I leave the
command to you!

note: Same speaker; asks Sakon to do it.

en:
Lord Mitsuhide is our
hope! I won't let you
touch him!

You Mouri lot! I'll
teach you a lesson you
won't forget!

This is what happens when
you let your guard down
just because I'm a woman!

See if you can take
this blow!

Hail Hachiman, great
bodhisattva! Please,
let it hit!
